subject.title: Cron "New Job" form misaligns the Description field after interacting with Agent ID

question: Should this issue be transferred to openclaw/openclaw now that the exact owning Cron UI source is confirmed there?
rationale: ClawHub has no implementation surface to repair, no canonical OpenClaw issue preserves the symptom, and repository transfer or canonical refiling requires maintainer action.

options.title: Transfer to OpenClaw
options.body: Move or recreate the report in openclaw/openclaw with the existing reproduction details and request current browser proof.

options.title: Close after canonical refiling
options.body: Close this issue only after a new OpenClaw issue is linked and preserves the symptom and discussion.

recommendation.title: Transfer to OpenClaw
recommendation.body: Move or recreate the report in openclaw/openclaw with the existing reproduction details and request current browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commit history shows the strongest ownership of the OpenClaw Cron page and its dialog-based creation flow.
